notes: Ludum Dare 38 horror jam game by Banana4Life. Git contributors: Faithcaio, pschichtel, JonasDann. Jam credits: Music & Sound by Katharina / Rahtainka (https://soundcloud.com/rahtainka; not in git history); Code: Anselm, Phillip; Art: Jonas. Jam page: https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/38/where-is-mommy. Complete Unity 2017.1 project with playable Intro, Main, and End scenes in EditorBuildSettings, first-person exploration scripts (PlayerController, PanicController, FlashlightController, keys/doors/teddy). GPL-3.0 at repo-root LICENSE. Third-party: UniRx (MIT, Yoshifumi Kawai) and Unity NavMeshComponents (MIT). No bundled fonts, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no LFS, no DLL. Omitted auto-generated JetBrains Rider editor postprocessor under Assets/Plugins/Editor/JetBrains/. Voxel sources retained under Raw/Voxel/. Restored ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt (2017.1.0xf3Linux) which upstream .gitignore would otherwise exclude. ~28M src snapshot.
